{{Quote|Tell me where the prisoners are housed.''"<br />"''Uh, each of the twenty-four zones has a worker restraint facility.|[[Galen Marek]] and a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]|<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (unabridged audiobook)}}</ref>}}
'''N6''' was one of twelve equally-sized zones on the northern hemisphere of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a massive [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Like the other twenty-three sections on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the zone covered 31.4 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of the Death Star's circumference, was commanded from a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], and contained a number of sectors with designated purposes.<ref name="DSTC" /> The Death Star, including zone N6, was destroyed in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Destruction date" /> Zone N6 bordered zones [[N5]] and [[Sector N-Seven|N7]].<ref name="DSTC" />

Zone N6 contained the [[Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor]]<ref name="CCG" /> and [[Tractor Beam 12/Legends|Tractor Beam 12]],<ref name="ANH" /> which were both located inside a [[tractor beam power-generator trench]].<ref name=""SW4">[[Star Wars (1977) 4|''Star Wars'' (1977) 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Aurebesh_2004.png|thumb|right|250px|The tractor beam information gauge, as it appears in the original film (top) and in the 2004 DVD version (bottom)]]
Zone N6 first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Its name "Sec. N6" was displayed on the information gauge of the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shut down aboard the Death Star. The words were written in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic]] in the original version of ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope''. They were [[List of changes in Star Wars re-releases#A New Hope 3|changed]] to [[Aurebesh]] in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars Trilogy (DVD)|DVD release]].<ref name="ANH" />
